payload.name: Extended Reality Digital Storytelling (XRDST) Effectiveness
payload.fact: XRDST-assisted learning has a statistically significant positive effect on learning outcomes, with higher effectiveness observed for K-12 learners compared to higher education learners.
payload.boundary: Effectiveness varies by learning environment and content type, with analytical and problem-solving skills showing higher effect sizes than declarative knowledge.

provenance.title: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Applying Extended Reality Digital Storytelling for Assisted Learning in Education
provenance.quote_or_locus: The results of the meta-analysis revealed that the overall effect size of XRDST-assisted learning was 0.465, which is statistically significant. The effect size for K-12 learners (0.583) was greater than that for higher education learners (0.258
